verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents Auto-Sync, which commits, pulls and pushes whenever changes are detected. Background Sync keeps that running while you use other apps, though it uses location and extra battery and pauses after long idle periods. It also supports automation through the Shortcuts app, but its AI Repository Agent is conversational and interactive rather than autonomous. Missing for 10: user-defined autonomous background automations beyond git sync, autonomous or scheduled AI-agent runs, documented background triggers for Shortcuts flows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
